reason: The two features I'd want are the ones that need my bank slips and my credit-card statement PDF uploaded to a new app, and I don't do that. Even at 69 baht it's the upload I'd hesitate over, not the price.
objection: I don't want to hand my statements or slip photos to a new app I've never heard of, and I'd forget to scan the slips every day anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that statements are parsed on my own device and never leave it, plus a way to delete everything with one tap.
